name: kimi-code
title: Kimi Code CLI
upstream: https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code (MIT). GitHub release @moonshot-ai/kimi-code@2.2.0 published 2026-10-14. Legacy MoonshotAI/kimi-cli is archived.
install: Install Node.js >=22.19 in the image (Express FC base is Node 20), then npm install -g @moonshot-ai/kimi-code@2.2.0. Do not use the unpinned curl installer at code.kimi.com.
headless_call: kimi -p "<prompt>" with KIMI_CODE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1. Catalog backlog also documents kimi --print -p for auto-approved tool calls. Confirm -p vs --print against 2.2.0 --help before freezing the command.
needs: Moonshot API key via the CLI provider config (exact env var name unverified on 2.2.0). No GPU, KVM, Docker, or display. Egress required.
rationale: OpenSandbox ships a kimi-cli example, and no catalog template covers Moonshot. The CLI is a single non-interactive process, same shape as gemini and qwen-code. Node 22 is an image install, not a platform blocker.

name: goose
title: Goose coding agent
upstream: https://github.com/block/goose (Apache-2.0). Release v1.54.0 published 2026-10-08.
install: Download and unpack https://github.com/block/goose/releases/download/v1.54.0/goose-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.bz2 (80,909,320 bytes on 2026-10-15). Do not use the floating stable/download_cli.sh. Skip vulkan and cuda assets.
headless_call: goose run -t "<text>" (long form --text). Provider and model come from goose config or env; exact key name depends on the chosen provider.
needs: An LLM API key for the configured provider. No GPU, KVM, Docker, or display. The CLI tarball is the target, not the Goose desktop app.
rationale: 55k-star AAIF agent with a documented one-shot command and a pinned Linux tarball. Same invocation shape the catalog already accepts for Claude, Codex, and Qwen.

name: pi
title: Pi coding agent
upstream: https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono (MIT). Release v1.2.0 published 2026-10-12. npm package @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent. E2B public alias pi. https://pi.dev/docs/latest/cli
install: Prefer the release tarball https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/releases/download/v1.2.0/pi-linux-x64.tar.gz (42,611,136 bytes). Whether that tarball bundles Node is unverified. Fallback: Node >=22.19 and npm install -g --ignore-scripts @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@1.2.0. Do not use pi.dev/install.sh.
headless_call: E2B docs (fetched 2026-10-15) use pi -p "<prompt>". pi.dev CLI docs say --print is the one-shot flag and that --mode text does not force exit. Confirm on v1.2.0. No auto-approve flag; built-in tools run as the process user.
needs: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or another provider key Pi accepts. No GPU, KVM, Docker, or display. Building this directory does not register E2B's public pi alias.
rationale: E2B and Vercel universal both ship Pi. It is a terminal coding agent with a print mode, so it fits the named-command contract. The earlier backlog objection was about E2B template registration, which this Express directory does not attempt.

name: browser-use
title: browser-use agent
upstream: https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use (MIT). Release 0.13.11 published 2026-10-07.
install: pip install browser-use==0.13.11 and the Chromium build that release documents (playwright install chromium, pinned to the Playwright version browser-use 0.13.11 depends on). Reuse the non-root Chromium launch flags from browser-automation.
headless_call: A small Python entry that constructs a browser-use Agent with task text and a headless Chromium, then prints the final result. The exact constructor kwargs for 0.13.11 were not re-read in this survey; pin them from that tag's README before coding.
needs: An LLM API key (provider depends on the agent config). Chromium, /dev/shm or --disable-dev-shm-usage. No GPU, KVM, or Docker. Display not required for headless Chromium.
rationale: 118k stars and actively pushed (2026-10-15). browser-automation only exposes Playwright primitives. browser-use is the agent loop competitors (including E2B kernel-browser) preinstall. It runs in the same headless Chromium this catalog already builds.

name: code-interpreter
title: Multi-language code interpreter
upstream: Match the capability of E2B code-interpreter-v1 (Apache-2.0, e2b-dev/code-interpreter) and OpenSandbox code-interpreter:v1.1.0. Do not copy either Dockerfile.
install: On the FC base image, pin jupyter-server, ipykernel, pandas, numpy, matplotlib, pillow to versions copied from e2b-dev/code-interpreter template/requirements.txt as fetched 2026-10-15 (jupyter-server==2.20.0, pandas==2.2.3, numpy==2.3.5, matplotlib==3.10.9). Add a Node 20 kernel only if it stays small. Defer spacy, opencv, librosa, and numba until a size check against the ~10G rootfs passes.
headless_call: Named command execute_code(language, code) that runs Python (and optionally node) and returns stdout, stderr, and an error string. No Jupyter port needs to be public for the first version.
needs: No API key for code execution. No GPU (CPU wheels only), KVM, Docker, or display. Egress only if a later command installs packages.
rationale: Every surveyed host ships a code-execution image, and this catalog only has python-hello plus node-web. A slim scientific Python interpreter fits Express. The full E2B library list is unverified against the 10G rootfs, so the first template should be the slim set.

name: linux-desktop
title: Headless Linux desktop (Xvfb + noVNC)
upstream: Pattern from E2B desktop (Ubuntu 22.04 XFCE, noVNC on 6080, xdotool, scrot) and OpenSandbox examples/desktop (Xvfb + x11vnc + fluxbox). Do not copy those Dockerfiles. noVNC is MPL-2.0; x11vnc is GPL-2.0.
install: apt packages pinned by Debian snapshot or apt version lock: xvfb, x11vnc, fluxbox or xfce4, novnc, websockify, xdotool, scrot. Run as user. Start Xvfb on :0 and noVNC on 6080 from a named command, not from ENTRYPOINT (platform forbids replacing entrypoint).
headless_call: desktop_start() then screenshot() via scrot or xwd, and input(text) via xdotool. Return the noVNC URL path on port 6080.
needs: No GPU and no KVM. Xvfb does not need a real display. No Docker. Non-root X and image size are unverified on Express. VNC password from env, empty in template.yaml.
rationale: This is the computer-use surface Express can host. It is not OSWorld. E2B, OpenSandbox, and CubeSandbox all expose a desktop, and this catalog does not.

name: cursor-agent
title: Cursor CLI agent
upstream: https://cursor.com/docs/cli/headless (fetched 2026-10-15). Install script https://cursor.com/install. No public GitHub repo for the CLI was found (getcursor/cursor has no license field).
install: The documented install is curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash, which does not pin a version. A versioned URL was not found. Do not ship until a checksummed binary URL is verified. Command name on PATH is agent.
headless_call: agent -p "<prompt>" with CURSOR_API_KEY. Docs also show --output-format json and --force. --trust and --sandbox disabled appear in a third-party SWE-rebench runner, not in the Cursor headless page read here.
needs: CURSOR_API_KEY. No GPU, KVM, Docker, or display. Egress to Cursor.
rationale: Fly Sprites and SWE-rebench both treat the Cursor CLI as a standard sandbox agent, and the headless flag is documented. It stays P1 until the install is reproducible.

name: grok
title: Grok Build CLI
upstream: E2B public template grok, https://docs.e2b.dev/agents/grok.md fetched 2026-10-15. xai-org/grok is the model release (Apache-2.0, last push 2024-08-30), not the CLI. No xai-org/grok-cli repo.
install: Upstream install documented in the catalog backlog is curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash, with no version pin. Do not add the directory until a versioned package or binary URL is verified.
headless_call: grok --always-approve -p "<prompt>" with XAI_API_KEY, as written in the E2B grok page.
needs: XAI_API_KEY, which this environment does not have. No GPU, KVM, Docker, or display. Grok's own --sandbox flag is a CLI permission mode, not this catalog.
rationale: The CLI shape matches existing coding templates and E2B already publishes alias grok. The only blocker called out previously is the unpinned installer, and that is still unverified.

name: code-server
title: code-server (VS Code Web)
upstream: https://github.com/coder/code-server (MIT). Release v4.141.0 published 2026-10-08. OpenSandbox example uses opensandbox/vscode:latest (unpinned).
install: Unpack https://github.com/coder/code-server/releases/download/v4.141.0/code-server-4.141.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz (239,926,515 bytes). Bind 127.0.0.1 or 0.0.0.0 on a fixed port as user, with PASSWORD or hashed password from env.
headless_call: code_server_start() launches code-server --bind-addr 0.0.0.0:8443 --auth password and returns the port. No LLM call.
needs: Password env var. No GPU, KVM, Docker, or display. ~240MB compressed archive; confirm it fits with the FC base on a ~10G rootfs.
rationale: OpenSandbox's vscode example and coder/code-server (79k stars, pushed 2026-10-14) are the dev-environment template this catalog lacks. It is a web server, not an agent, so it ranks behind the coding CLIs.

name: mini-swe-agent
title: mini-swe-agent local runner
upstream: https://github.com/SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent (MIT). Release v2.4.6 published 2026-07-23.
install: pip install mini-swe-agent==2.4.6. Use the local environment backend that edits the sandbox filesystem directly. Do not enable the Docker or bubblewrap backends.
headless_call: mini with a task string and a model config, non-interactive, writing a patch under the workdir. Exact argv for v2.4.6 was not re-read; take it from that tag's README. Official SWE-bench scoring stays out of this template.
needs: An LLM API key. A git checkout of the target repo inside the sandbox. No Docker, KVM, or GPU. Egress for the model API and for git clone.
rationale: This is the SWE-shaped tool Express can run: one agent, one repo, a patch. The official SWE-bench and SWE-rebench harnesses need per-instance Docker images, which Express cannot start.

name: aider
title: Aider pair-programming CLI
upstream: https://github.com/Aider-AI/aider (Apache-2.0). Release v0.86.0 published 2025-08-09. Repo pushed_at 2026-05-22, outside the last three months.
install: pip install aider-chat==0.86.0. Confirm the console script name is aider.
headless_call: aider --yes --message "<prompt>" in a git repository. It edits files and exits.
needs: A model API key (OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY depending on --model). git. No GPU, KVM, Docker, or display.
rationale: Still the reference headless edit-and-exit CLI, and the install pin is a normal PyPI version. Ranked P1 because upstream has not shipped a release since 2025-08.

name: playwright-mcp
title: Playwright MCP server
upstream: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp (Apache-2.0). Release v0.0.83 published 2026-09-28.
install: npm install -g @playwright/mcp@0.0.83 and the matching Playwright browser. Prefer folding this into browser-automation if that image already has Chromium; a separate directory only if the MCP process needs its own start command.
headless_call: npx @playwright/mcp@0.0.83 --headless --port 8931. Named command mcp_start returns the port. Tool calls then go over MCP, not a one-shot prompt.
needs: Chromium. No LLM key inside the template. No GPU, KVM, or Docker.
rationale: 38k stars and the standard way for coding agents to drive a browser. The catalog's browser-automation template does not speak MCP.

name: document-tools
title: pandoc and headless LibreOffice
upstream: pandoc (GPL-2.0) and LibreOffice (MPL-2.0). Pin Debian package versions at build time. E2B desktop includes LibreOffice but not as a headless conversion API.
install: apt-get install specific versions of pandoc and libreoffice-writer (or soffice). Record the versions in the image build log.
headless_call: convert(input_path, output_format) runs pandoc or soffice --headless --convert-to and returns the output path.
needs: No API key, GPU, KVM, Docker, or display. soffice --headless is unverified as non-root on the FC base; it usually works with a temporary HOME.
rationale: Agents that produce docx, pdf, and slides show up in E2B's desktop image and in data workflows, and nothing in the catalog converts documents.

name: dev-services
title: Postgres and Redis without Docker
upstream: PostgreSQL and Redis upstream packages. Pin Debian versions. Not a published agent template elsewhere; Daytona and Runloop expect users to start these themselves, often via Docker-in-Docker, which Express cannot do.
install: apt install pinned postgresql and redis-server. Init a data directory under /home/user. Start with pg_ctl and redis-server --daemonize no under the user account, or via a named command. Do not use the system init scripts that expect root.
headless_call: services_start() then a readiness check on 5432 and 6379. Optional seed SQL argument.
needs: No API key, GPU, KVM, or Docker. Non-root Postgres init is a known pattern but was not executed on Express in this survey.
rationale: App backends need a database, and the usual sandbox answer (Docker Compose) is impossible here. User-space Postgres and Redis are the substitute.

name: copilot-cli
title: GitHub Copilot CLI
upstream: https://github.com/github/copilot-cli (license SPDX NOASSERTION). Latest GitHub release returned on 2026-10-15 is prerelease v1.0.99-0. OpenSandbox example github-copilot-cli-sandbox exists.
install: Unverified. Do not use a floating install script. Wait for a non-prerelease npm or GitHub asset and pin that. A third-party page claims the binary is copilot.
headless_call: Unverified on upstream docs in this survey. A secondary page (developertoolkit.ai, fetched 2026-10-15) shows copilot -p "..." and copilot --allow-all-tools. Confirm with --help on the pinned build.
needs: A GitHub Copilot token (GH_TOKEN or GH_COPILOT_TOKEN; exact name unverified). No GPU, KVM, Docker, or display.
rationale: OpenSandbox already demonstrates it, and Copilot is a mainstream coding CLI. The pin and the headless flags are not verified, so it is not P0.

name: crush
title: Crush coding agent
upstream: https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush (license SPDX NOASSERTION, 28,642 stars, pushed 2026-10-15). Latest GitHub release returned is prerelease tag nightly.
install: A third-party page cites npm @charmland/crush and crush --yolo. Neither the package version nor a stable git tag was verified. Pin a non-nightly release or an npm version before building.
headless_call: Unverified. Secondary source says crush --yolo. Confirm a non-interactive prompt flag.
needs: A model API key. No GPU, KVM, Docker, or display assumed; unverified.
rationale: Active and widely starred, and it is a terminal agent rather than an IDE fork. Held at P1 because the reproducible install is not verified.

name: cline
title: Cline CLI
upstream: https://github.com/cline/cline (Apache-2.0). Release v4.1.24 published 2026-10-13. 70,337 stars.
install: Unverified. The project is an SDK, IDE extension, and CLI. Find the CLI package at tag v4.1.24 and pin it. Do not install the VS Code extension.
headless_call: Unverified on upstream docs. A secondary page says cline --yolo. Confirm a prompt flag that exits.
needs: A model API key. No GPU, KVM, or Docker if the CLI mode does not shell out to Docker (unverified).
rationale: Cline is one of the largest active coding-agent repos and now claims a CLI. It becomes P0 only after the headless argv and the package name are read from the v4.1.24 tree.

name: deepagents
title: LangChain Deep Agents harness
upstream: https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents (MIT). Release deepagents==0.7.25 published 2026-10-14. OpenSandbox example examples/deep-agents. E2B has an integration page but no public template alias.
install: pip install deepagents==0.7.25. Whether 0.7.25 ships a console script was not verified.
headless_call: Unverified. If the package exposes a CLI that takes a task and exits, wrap that. Otherwise a short Python driver that runs one deep agent turn against the local filesystem is the command. Do not start a sibling sandbox.
needs: An LLM API key. No GPU, KVM, or Docker for the in-process filesystem backend. Egress to the model API.
rationale: 30k stars, a release the week of this survey, and both E2B and OpenSandbox document it. The missing piece is a confirmed one-shot entry point.

name: tau2-bench
title: tau2-bench tool-use harness
upstream: https://github.com/sierra-research/tau2-bench (MIT). Release v1.0.1 published 2026-07-22.
install: pip install from the v1.0.1 tag (pyproject version unverified; pin the git tag if there is no matching PyPI release). Tasks are simulated domains, not live websites.
headless_call: The upstream runner for one domain and a user simulator. Exact module path was not re-read; take it from the v1.0.1 README.
needs: An LLM API key for the agent and often for the user simulator. No browser, Docker, KVM, or GPU.
rationale: tau2 is a tool-use eval that does not need a VM or Docker, unlike OSWorld, AndroidWorld, and SWE-bench. It is a harness template, so it ranks after the coding CLIs.

name: polyglot-toolchain
title: Go, Rust, and Java toolchains
upstream: Official Go, Rustup, and Temurin/OpenJDK tarballs. OpenSandbox code-interpreter preinstalls Java 8/11/17/21, Node 18/20/22, and Go 1.23/1.24/1.25. Pin one version of each, not a matrix.
install: One pinned tarball each: Go (match 1.25.x), a rustup default toolchain with an explicit rust version, and Temurin 21. Skip the multi-version switcher. Verify the three together fit in the ~10G rootfs.
headless_call: toolchain_versions() prints go version, rustc --version, and java -version. No agent loop.
needs: No API key, GPU, KVM, Docker, or display. Network only at build time.
rationale: Coding agents fail on repos that need a compiler the FC base does not have. A single toolchain layer is more useful than three half-installed languages. Size is the risk.

name: ocr
title: Tesseract OCR
upstream: Tesseract (Apache-2.0). Pin the Debian tesseract-ocr package and English traineddata.
install: apt install a pinned tesseract-ocr and tesseract-ocr-eng.
headless_call: ocr(image_path) runs tesseract <image> stdout and returns the text.
needs: No API key, GPU, KVM, Docker, or display.
rationale: Small, reproducible, and useful for document agents. Lower priority than pandoc/LibreOffice because fewer benchmark and product templates depend on it.

name: media-tools
title: ffmpeg media tools
upstream: ffmpeg. License of the Debian build varies with the enabled libraries; record the package's license at pin time. E2B desktop installs ffmpeg for screen capture.
install: apt install a pinned ffmpeg. Do not enable CUDA or nonfree builds.
headless_call: ffmpeg_run(args) with an argument list, not a shell string. A thin transcode(input, output) wrapper is enough.
needs: No API key, GPU, KVM, Docker, or display. CPU encode only.
rationale: Agents that trim or transcode media need ffmpeg, and it installs cleanly without Docker. It is not a product template competitors lead with, so it is P2.

name: stagehand
title: Stagehand browser SDK
upstream: https://github.com/browserbase/stagehand (MIT). Latest release returned is stagehand-server-v3/v3.7.6 published 2026-08-28. npm package name was not re-checked.
install: Pin the npm version that matches that server release after reading its package.json. Local Chromium, not Browserbase, unless a Browserbase key is provided.
headless_call: A Node script that calls stagehand against headless Chromium with an instruction string. Exact API for v3.7.6 unverified.
needs: An LLM API key plus Chromium, or BROWSERBASE_API_KEY if using their cloud browsers. No GPU, KVM, or Docker for local Chromium.
rationale: 25k stars and a real SDK, but browser-use covers the same job with a clearer Python install. Build stagehand only if a Node-first caller appears.

name: prime-agent
title: Prime Agent
upstream: https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent (license SPDX NOASSERTION, 22,034 stars). E2B public alias prime. Latest GitHub release returned on 2026-10-15 is prerelease nightly (2026-10-01).
install: E2B runs prime-agent. A pinned non-nightly install was not found. Do not use a floating installer.
headless_call: E2B docs: prime-agent -p "<prompt>" with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. No approval flag. First-run /login is interactive and must be avoided by passing the env key.
needs: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or another provider. Docs mention a persistent IPython kernel. No GPU, KVM, or Docker stated. Unverified whether the kernel needs extra packages.
rationale: E2B ships it and the headless flag is documented, but the only release tag visible is nightly, so it fails the reproducible-install bar.

name: appworld
title: AppWorld function-calling benchmark
upstream: https://github.com/stonybrooknlp/appworld (Apache-2.0). Release v0.1.3.post1 published 2026-02-17.
install: Pin the v0.1.3.post1 install extra from that tag. Dependency weight and whether it shells out to Docker were not verified.
headless_call: The upstream experiment runner for one task. Exact command unverified.
needs: An LLM API key. Docker requirement unverified. No GPU or KVM expected.
rationale: A controllable apps benchmark with a real release, but it is older than tau2 and the runtime assumptions were not verified. Prefer tau2-bench first.
